refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.JournalAccess is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# Journal log read APIs interface io.systemd.JournalAccess
# Retrieve journal log entries, optionally filtered by unit, priority, etc. # [Requires 'more' flag] method GetEntries( # Show messages for the specified systemd units (e.g. ['foo.service']). units: ?[]string, # UID to match user units for uid: ?int, # Show messages for the specified user units (e.g. ['foo.service']). userUnits: ?[]string, # If specified, shows the log data of the specified namespace, otherwise the default namespace. namespace: ?string, # Filter output by message priorities or priority ranges (i.e. between 0/'emerg' and 7/'debug') priority: ?int, # Maximum number of entries to return. Defaults to 100, capped at 10000. limit: ?int, # If true, do not complete after sending the newest entries: keep the call open and stream new entries as they are logged, until the client disconnects. The limit parameter then bounds only the initial backlog. follow: ?bool ) -> ( # The journal entry in flat JSON format, matching journalctl --output=json. entry: object )
# No matches found for specified unit patterns error NoMatches()
# No journal entries matched the specified filters. error NoEntries()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.JournalAccess shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.JournalAccess.GetEntries '{}' invokes its GetEntries method.
